body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Naples, Italy. It starts at Sentiero del Gran Cono.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit Vesuvius at your own pace. This tour includes a skip-the-line entrance ticket and a guidebook about the history and trails of the volcano.
>
> Spend as much time as you want, reaching the top, viewing the crater, and seeing the Gulf of Naples.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.84. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 160 ratings and 106 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
